name: beatapi-agent-plugin
description: Use BeatAPI text, image, video, Effects, workflows, analysis, and realtime APIs from Cursor and Grok Bot.

BEATAPI_API_KEY.title: BeatAPI API key
BEATAPI_API_KEY.description: Create a key at https://beatapi.io/dashboard/apikeys. The value is injected into the local MCP server and is never stored in this repository.

BEATAPI_BASE_URL.title: BeatAPI base URL
BEATAPI_BASE_URL.description: Optional API base URL override. Keep the default unless BeatAPI support gave you another endpoint.
